1. Small stickers traded: 90% of 30 = 27 small stickers.
   Since 3 small stickers = 1 large button, she receives $27 / 3 = 9$ large buttons.

2. Large stickers traded for large buttons: 50% of 40 = 20 large stickers.
   Since 1 large sticker = 1 large button, she receives 20 large buttons.

3. Remaining large stickers traded for small buttons: 20 large stickers.
   Since 1 large sticker = 3 small buttons, she receives $20 \times 3 = 60$ small buttons.

Total buttons: $9 \text{ (large)} + 20 \text{ (large)} + 60 \text{ (small)} = 89$ buttons.

ANSWER: 89
